purpose: Classify migration files without rewriting applied production history.

classifications.description: History or receipt file that points at an already-live executable authority.
Temporary, recovery, probe, or retirement control retained for immutable history.
Default executable migration authority when no receipt/history marker applies.

invariants: Every migration is classified exactly once.
Every Canonical executable authority receipt points to a file that exists.
Receipt files are never treated as a second executable authority.
